courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的水利與海岸設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring water and coastal works through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 棧橋式碼頭樁基
related.transfer: 可遷移「浮台載重與吃水」與「並聯恢復剛度」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；棧橋式碼頭樁基的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Pontoon loading and draft" and "Parallel restoring stiffness" transfer, while hydraulic boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Pile-supported pier foundations must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦辨識浮碼頭浮力纜繩幾何與岸上通道的耦合反應；棧橋式碼頭樁基則以由海床調查到樁群變形與耐久追蹤棧橋碼頭荷載為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on identify coupled buoyancy, mooring geometry and shore-access response of floating docks; Pile-supported pier foundations centres on trace pile-supported pier loads from seabed investigation to group deformation and durability, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「浮台載重與吃水」與「鋼管截面與軸應力」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到棧橋式碼頭樁基，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「沖刷與側向剛度」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Pontoon loading and draft” and “Steel-pipe section and axial stress”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Pile-supported pier foundations, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Scour and lateral stiffness", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 浮動碼頭繫泊系統
history.text: 浮碼頭讓登船面隨潮升降，但也把浮體、繫泊和岸上引橋連成同一系統。香港主管機關記錄二〇二一年海岸風險研究，並以馬料水與三門仔浮台作水位調適背景；二〇二五年九月新馬料水碼頭啟用公告明列浮台與引橋。現行美國官方書目在二〇二六年九月列小型船舶靠泊設施新版，舊站仍有較早版本，因此引用必須標明版本及已閱讀範圍。本課不聲稱取得這些碼頭的纜具配置，所有重量、角度及剛度均為合成示意，用來辨識浮力與力路徑如何耦合。
history.textEn: Floating docks follow tide but couple the pontoon, mooring and shore gangway into one system. Hong Kong records its2021 coastal-hazards study and identifies Ma Liu Shui and Sam Mun Tsai pontoons in an adaptation context; the September2025 opening announcement explicitly describes the new Ma Liu Shui platform and gangway. The current US catalogue lists a September2026 small-craft guide while a legacy site retains older issues, requiring clear version and reading-scope identification. This course does not claim access to those piers’ mooring configurations. All weights, angles and stiffnesses are synthetic illustrations of buoyancy and coupled load paths.

history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「浮台載重與吃水」到「浮力儲備與損艙」改寫為 40 個原創分析、試驗與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿、設計圖或現場程序。
